title: EngineAudioProfile
description: The 'data' object of Data/Audio/*.json. Mirrors FLREngineAudioProfile (Source/LRAudio/Public/LRAudioTypes.h). Gains are linear, frequencies in Hz, times in seconds, speeds in km/h. Missing fields keep the C++ defaults.

Id.description: Unique id, equal to the file name without extension (e.g. "engine_i6_turbo").

CylinderCount.description: Number of cylinders of the four-stroke engine (firing frequency = rpm / 60 * cylinders / 2).

Harmonics.description: Partials of the engine tone (at most MaxHarmonics are used). Empty = built-in default set.

OffLoadLevel.description: Engine level multiplier with the throttle closed (overrun is quieter than full load), 0..1.

IdleLevel.description: Engine level multiplier at idle rpm relative to the rev limiter, 0..1 (level rises linearly with rpm).

OffLoadCutoffHz.description: Low-pass cutoff of the engine tone with the throttle closed, Hz.

OnLoadCutoffHz.description: Low-pass cutoff of the engine tone at full throttle, Hz.

CutoffRpmTracking.description: How much the tone cutoff follows rpm (0 = fixed, 1 = proportional to rpm / max rpm).

Drive.description: Pre-gain of the soft clipper that adds grit at high load, 0.5..8 (1 = almost clean).

CycleJitter.description: Random frequency deviation applied per engine cycle, fraction of the firing frequency, 0..0.05.

AmplitudeJitter.description: Random amplitude deviation applied per engine cycle, 0..0.5 (combustion roughness).

IntakeNoiseGain.description: Level of the intake roar (band-passed noise), 0..1.

IntakeNoiseOrder.description: Center of the intake noise band, as a multiple of the firing frequency, 0.5..16.

IntakeNoiseQ.description: Quality factor of the intake noise band-pass, 0.3..10.

ExhaustNoiseGain.description: Level of the exhaust pulse noise (low-passed noise gated by every firing), 0..1.

ExhaustNoiseCutoffHz.description: Low-pass cutoff of the exhaust pulse noise, Hz.

OverrunCrackleProbability.description: Probability per firing of an overrun crackle (throttle closed, high rpm), 0..0.5.

OverrunMinRpmFraction.description: Crackles only above this fraction of the max rpm, 0..1.

LimiterRpmFraction.description: The rev limiter stutter starts at this fraction of the max rpm, 0.8..1.

LimiterCutHz.description: Rate of the rev limiter fuel cut, Hz.

RpmSmoothingSeconds.description: Time constant of the rpm smoothing inside the audio thread, seconds (keep short so gear shifts snap).

LoadSmoothingSeconds.description: Time constant of the throttle / load smoothing, seconds.

EngineCutFadeSeconds.description: Fade time of the engine when it is cut (crash) or restarted, seconds.

FallbackMaxRpm.description: Max rpm used when the vehicle reports none, rpm.

WindGain.description: Wind level at WindReferenceSpeedKmh, 0..2 (scales with speed squared).

WindReferenceSpeedKmh.description: Speed at which the wind reaches WindGain, km/h.

WindMaxScale.description: Upper bound of the wind level scale (v / vref)^2, 0..4.

WindLowHz.description: Center of the wind noise band at standstill, Hz.

WindHighHz.description: Center of the wind noise band at the reference speed, Hz.

WindQ.description: Quality factor of the wind band-pass, 0.3..10.

WindGustDepth.description: Depth of the slow gust modulation, 0..1.

WindGustRateHz.description: Rate of the gust modulation, Hz.

TyreGain.description: Tyre / road rumble level at TyreReferenceSpeedKmh, 0..2.

TyreReferenceSpeedKmh.description: Speed at which the rumble reaches TyreGain, km/h.

TyreSpeedExponent.description: Exponent of the rumble level vs speed curve, 0.3..3.

TyreCutoffHz.description: Low-pass cutoff of the rumble noise, Hz.

JointSpacingMeters.description: Distance between expansion joints along S, meters (0 disables the thumps).

JointGain.description: Level of each expansion joint thump at the tyre reference speed, 0..2.

JointToneHz.description: Pitch of the joint thump, Hz.

JointDecaySeconds.description: Decay time constant of each joint thump, seconds.

WhooshGain.description: Peak level of a full-intensity whoosh, 0..2.

WhooshStartHz.description: Band center at the start of the sweep, Hz.

WhooshEndHz.description: Band center at the end of the sweep, Hz (lower than the start: Doppler-like fall).

WhooshQ.description: Quality factor of the whoosh band-pass, 0.3..10.

WhooshReferenceRelativeKmh.description: Relative speed that produces a full-intensity whoosh, km/h.

WhooshClearanceFalloffMeters.description: Intensity falls as exp(-clearance / falloff), meters.

WhooshMaxPan.description: Maximum stereo pan of the whoosh toward the passed side, 0..1.

WhooshSideProbeRadiusMeters.description: Distance along the road, ahead and behind the player, searched for the passed vehicle to find its side, meters.

CrashGain.description: Peak level of the crash burst, 0..2.

CrashDurationSeconds.description: Decay time of the crash burst, seconds.

CrashCutoffHz.description: Low-pass cutoff of the crash noise, Hz.

CrashThumpHz.description: Pitch of the low body thump of the crash, Hz.

CrashReferenceKmh.description: Impact speed that produces a full-intensity crash, km/h.

MasterGain.description: Output level before the final soft clipper, 0..2.

InteriorEngineCutoffHz.description: Cabin camera: low-pass cutoff applied to the engine, Hz.

InteriorTyreGain.description: Cabin camera: tyre and joint level multiplier (structure-borne boom), 0..2.

MixSmoothingSeconds.description: Crossfade time between the exterior and cabin mixes, seconds.

Harmonic.description: One partial of the engine tone. Mirrors FLREngineHarmonic.

Order.description: Multiple of the firing frequency (rounded to the nearest 0.5 at runtime).

OffLoadGain.description: Linear amplitude with the throttle closed.
